# Progress

Usage meter for CPU, RAM, disk, quota or a running job.

`KenosUI.Progress` · Homelab

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Progress value={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Progress" value="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (ProgressProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` * | `number` |  |
| `max` | `number` | Default 100. |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `valueText` | `React.ReactNode \| false` | Right-hand text; default "NN %". `false` hides it. |
| `palette` | `"primary" \| "accent" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "error" \| "neutral"` | Fixed colour. Without it the bar colours itself by `thresholds`. |
| `thresholds` | `[number, number] \| false` | [warning, critical] in percent. Default [75, 90]: below = black, ≥75 orange, ≥90 red. `false` = always primary. |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Track height 6 / 8 / 10 / 12px. Default "sm". |
| `shape` | `"rounded" \| "full"` | "full" = pill track. Default rounded (radius-l1). |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "children">._
